Uplink Post Kit

My private tool for publishing every day: drafts, review, scheduling and posting from the phone.

Private. Walkthrough on request at support@lemonshops.app.How to useIn motion

01

Problem

Content drafted in chat conversations gets lost, and scheduling in three different apps leaves no single record of what was posted.

02

What it does

A queue of scheduled posts with previews and a status for each. I approve or request changes from the phone; a button then copies the caption for each platform and opens the share sheet with the files. Other views hold daily talking-to-camera scripts, run sheets for live sessions, and saved videos summarized into notes and a 42-move playbook.

03

How it is built

React and Postgres. Drafts are inserted directly into the database and media is served from a CDN. The tool is not public; the same system is offered as a service.

04
